title: Prepare launch brief and staged changelog approval process
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: produce a single-page launch brief and a staged changelog workflow (internal preview -> partner preview -> public release) for runtime-1.20 that surfaces customer-impacting changes, migration notes, and rollback guidance. The deliverables are: 1) a 1-page launch brief for sales/CS/marketing, 2) canonical customer-facing changelog draft in Markdown, 3) an internal-only detailed change log (engineering notes, SLO deltas, config toggles), and 4) the approval matrix and publish schedule. This ticket coordinates stakeholder review, gathers technical notes from runtime/infra, and validates wording with legal and security for KMS/HSM references.
acceptance_criteria: Launch one-pager approved by GTM (Marketing, Sales enablement, CS) and linked in the release kit
Customer-facing changelog Markdown file reviewed by Eng (runtime+infra) and Legal, no outstanding accuracy issues
Internal detailed changelog (engineering appendix) uploaded to Drive and linked from the release brief
Publish schedule documented with exact times, channels (docs site, status page, changelog RSS), and rollback messaging
Approval matrix shows at least PM, Eng lead, Legal, Security, and Docs sign-off with timestamps
tasks: Draft 1-page launch brief (PM) - include TL;DR, top customer impacts, migration notes, escalation path
Collect runtime-1.20 engineering notes from ENG leads: batching changes, KV cache behavior, kernel swap list
Create customer-facing changelog draft (Markdown) and annotate with audience tags (Developers | Platform | Admins)
Run Legal review on wording related to encryption/KMS and SLA language
Security to validate that the changelog does not disclose internal IP or sensitive config examples
Coordinate internal preview with Sales & CS on 2026-03-05 (feedback deadline 2026-03-07)
Prepare partner preview package for two strategic customers (alpha partners) with opt-in feedback loop
Finalize publish schedule and update docs site CI with the changelog artifact
Publish customer changelog and one-pager; notify mailing lists and product newsletter
